result.description: Compact desktop USB-C audio interface for solo creators, featuring 2-in/2-out recording, 24-bit/192 kHz conversion, a zero-latency direct monitor switch, and dual combo mic/line inputs with individual gain controls. Designed for podcasting, streaming, and voice-over work, it includes a headphone output with dedicated volume knob, balanced monitor outputs, and bus-powered operation for quick portable setups.
result.title: AsterLoom PrismKey N1 USB-C Audio Interface
result.title_description: A compact 2-in/2-out USB-C audio interface for recording, streaming, and podcasting.
